files_summary.world.json: Finance domain: gmail (55 AP messages), quickbooks (60 invoices, 45 expenses, 3 accounts), google_sheets (AR aging + expense log derived from invoices).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: quickbooks_list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: Lists QuickBooks invoices and returns the matching invoice records, optionally filtered by status (open, paid, or overdue). It refuses requests with an unsupported status value because it can only filter by the statuses it tracks.

tool_schemas.name: quickbooks_get_invoice
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns a single QuickBooks invoice by its id. It refuses requests that omit the id or reference an invoice that doesn’t exist.

tool_schemas.name: quickbooks_record_payment
tool_schemas.description: Records a payment against the specified invoice and returns the updated invoice with its balances/status adjusted accordingly. It refuses requests with a missing invoice_id, a missing/invalid amount, an amount that is not positive, or an invoice_id that doesn’t match an existing invoice, because it can only apply payments to known invoices with valid payment amounts.

tool_schemas.name: quickbooks_ar_summary
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns accounts-receivable totals as of the requested date, including open, overdue, and paid balances. It refuses requests with an as_of_date that isn’t a valid ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) because the totals must be computed against a real calendar date.

as_of_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) to compute AR totals as of; defaults to today when omitted.

tool_schemas.name: google_sheets_list_spreadsheets
tool_schemas.description: Lists available Google Sheets spreadsheets and returns a (possibly paginated) set of spreadsheet records. It refuses requests where limit is not an integer greater than zero or where cursor is not a valid continuation token, because it only supports bounded pagination with its own cursors.

limit.description: Maximum number of spreadsheets to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: google_sheets_get_values
tool_schemas.description: Returns all rows from the first worksheet of the specified spreadsheet, as a list of lists. It refuses requests that omit the spreadsheet identifier or that specify a name/id that doesn’t match any accessible spreadsheet.

tool_schemas.name: google_sheets_append_row
tool_schemas.description: Appends a new row to the first worksheet of the specified spreadsheet and returns the updated sheet data or append result. It refuses requests with a missing spreadsheet, a spreadsheet that can’t be found, or a missing/invalid row (must be an array of strings), because it can only append well-formed rows to known spreadsheets.

row.description: Cell values for the new row.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_find_email
tool_schemas.description: Finds and returns Gmail messages that match the provided filters (sender substring, subject substring, and/or label). It refuses requests with an unsupported label value because it can only filter on labels that exist in the mailbox.

from_contains.description: Substring to match the message 'from_' address.

label.description: Label id filter, e.g. INBOX or SENT.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_get_message
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns a single Gmail message by its id. It refuses requests that omit the id or reference a message id that doesn’t exist in the mailbox.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_send_email
tool_schemas.description: Sends a new email and returns the created message record as it appears in Sent. It refuses requests with no recipients, an empty/invalid recipient list, missing subject/body, or non-string address entries, because it only sends well-formed messages with at least one valid destination.

metadata.name: LedgerPulse Ops Hub
metadata.description: A finance-operations automation service that centralizes receivables, expenses, spreadsheet activity, and email communications into one API for invoicing, payment posting, reporting, and workflow-driven outreach.
